channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Waterspouts spotted over Indian River Lagoon as severe storms batter Sebastian and Port St. Lucie
item.description: Friday's severe weather left a trail of impacts across the Treasure Coast, including waterspouts over the lagoon, lightning strikes and fires in Port St. Lucie.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff ramps up traffic enforcement with 1,162 stops in four weeks
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies to target speeding and reckless driving on Midway Road, U.S. Highway 1 and Indian River Drive.

item.title: DEA chief joins Florida fentanyl summit in Orlando as overdose crisis continues
item.description: Teens from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined grieving parents and DEA Administrator Terrance Cole at a Florida summit this week to discuss stopping fentanyl.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route after nine months, citing low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. The airline cited low demand as the reason for ending the route, which launched last December to excitement from Treasure Coast residents hoping for conve

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis Jr. join Miami Heat in blockbuster trade
item.description: The Miami Heat introduced two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo and forward Bobby Portis Jr. at the Kaseya Center on Thursday, with both players receiving standing ovations from fans.

item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 season on road against Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes
item.description: The Florida Panthers will begin their 2026-27 NHL regular season with four Western Conference road games before returning to Amerant Bank Arena for their home opener.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 with late goals, advances to World Cup final Sunday
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with goals from Enzo Fernandez and substitute Lautaro Martinez to defeat England in the World Cup semifinal Wednesday.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks 27-year-old mile world record in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 at Saturday's Diamond League event in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's previous mark of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: World Cup Final ticket prices reach $7,700 for cheapest seats, nearly identical to median monthly US household income
item.description: The cheapest ticket on resale sites for Sunday's World Cup Final in New Jersey currently costs about $7,700, nearly identical to what the median U.S. household earns in an entire month.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: MLB made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent the tablets from running artificial intelligence to help make in-game decisions.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month. item.title: Leon County jury orders Florida Rep. Fabian Basabe to pay $450,000 in sexual harassment case
item.description: A Leon County jury found Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation, ordering him to pay $450,000 to a former legislative aide, former intern and the aide's mother.

item.title: Florida voter data surfaces in declassified intelligence reports as Trump renews election security push
item.description: Declassified White House records show a Chinese cyber actor downloaded publicly available Florida voter registration information in 2022, though the reports do not indicate ballots or vote totals were altered.

item.title: Byron Donalds and David Jolly lead Florida governor's race as primary nears
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly hold commanding advantages in their respective primaries as Florida's August 18 gubernatorial primary approaches.

item.title: Democratic Rep. Angie Nixon to stand trial in September on charges from Capitol sit-in
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Orlando fentanyl summit draws teens, grieving parents and DEA chief as overdose crisis continues
item.description: Teens from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined grieving parents and federal law enforcement at the Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando this week.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers Florida homeowners rates by 5.6 percent, launches disappearing deductible
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6 percent, the latest in a series of rate decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs low-altitude Blue Angels flyover in Pensacola as safety reviews draw scrutiny
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended low-altitude military flyovers after a Navy Blue Angels jet flew so low over a crowded Pensacola beach Wednesday that chairs and tents went flying, sand kicked up and children held their hands over their ears. The Navy initially said it was conducting a thorou

item.title: Palm Beach County man leads Martin County deputies on high-speed chase through Indiantown
item.description: A Palm Beach County man led Martin County deputies on a high-speed chase through Indiantown after driving more than 100 mph on State Road 710, forcing other vehicles off the roadway.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap over next 20 years
item.description: Martin County estimates it will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years, but only $701 million is currently available, meaning the county can fund just about one quarter of its identified needs.

item.title: Jonathan Dickinson State Park concession closure leaves visitors without boats and tours
item.description: Jonathan Dickinson State Park's concession operation is closed indefinitely this summer, leaving visitors without access to boat rentals, canoe rentals, and the popular Loxahatchee Queen tour to Trapper Nelson's Island.

item.title: Martin County brush fires contained, Florida Forest Service expects more this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast providing free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying residents in Martin County.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: A Hobe Sound couple is asking for community support as they navigate a cancer diagnosis, holding onto faith every step of the way.

item.title: Murray Middle School demolition underway after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Murray Middle School demolition is underway in Martin County, marking the start of a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage caused by Hurricane Milton. The project includes reconstruction of buildings destroyed in the tornadoes, along with a new administration building, media center, a

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office arrests nephew in fatal shooting of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes
item.description: Dale A. Mincey, 41, was formally charged with first-degree murder Saturday in connection with the death of his uncle, 66-year-old Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return home nearly 2 years after structural damage forced evacuation in St. Lucie County
item.description: Residents of buildings 3, 4, and 5 at Villa Del Sol in St. Lucie County were notified last month they could return to their condos after an August 2024 inspection found structural damage.

item.title: Fort Pierce neighbors pack planning meeting over Causeway Cove high-rise development proposal
item.description: The Causeway Cove development project off Seaway Drive includes five high-rise buildings, including a 17-story building standing 192 feet tall, more than four times the city's height limit.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights rezoning of lot behind their home near Tradition
item.description: Joseph and Margaret Mucciolo are searching for answers after Port St. Lucie City Council voted to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman turns $20 scratch-off into $5 million jackpot
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, claimed a $5 million top prize from the $5,000,000 CROSSWORD CASH scratch-off game on April 6.

item.title: Applications open for free or reduced-price school meals in Indian River County
item.description: Families in Indian River County can apply for free or reduced price meals for students starting July 15. Students at six Indian River County schools can receive free meals during the 2026-2027 school year through federal nutrition programs.
